company.shortDescription: naqla simplifies the process of goods transportation and provides efficient and hassle-free shipment through mobile App.
company.description: Naqla provides a more affordable, efficient, and transparent alternative for participants by using app-based technology to connect independent carriers with cargo companies to generate the best rate and most efficient paths for both parties.

productsAndServices.name: Naqla Store

productsAndServices.description: An AI-driven system that optimizes delivery routes and truck utilization by planning efficient round trips and reducing empty return trips (backhauling).
productsAndServices.name: AI-Powered Route Optimization and Backhauling

productsAndServices.description: A tracking system providing near real-time visibility of shipments, trucks, warehouses, and financials to enable supply chain monitoring and control.
productsAndServices.name: Real-Time Shipment and Fleet Tracking

productsAndServices.description: Transportation services covering heavy and light trucking within Egypt, distribution from warehouses to shelves, port cargo transport, and cross-border freight movement.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $10,500,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $46,219,211 to $46,219,211, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 64 (+0 over 90 days) and market heat at 66 (-2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
